artboards.title: Clear the deck — read me first

annotations.text: Start with the cover: the count at HEAD, the floor every concept shares, and the owner's four calls (H-73). The six concepts follow in two rows — by noun, by time, by place; then by question, by default, by face. Every board redraws the shop home for Blue Mantis on Thursday, August 27 at 6:40 AM, at desktop and at 390.
Row 1 — what the staff app is organised by: the noun (1 · Three words), the date (2 · The week), the place you are standing (3 · Ashore and aboard).

Row 2 — the question (4 · Ask), the default (5 · The shop's card), the shop's own page (6 · One face). 5 composes with every other concept; 6 needs 3's boat half. The recommendation on the cover: 5 now, then 1 with 4 as its search, then 3's boat.
